notes.title: Press Axe now supports MacOS and Demo!
notes.content:
[h2]Press Axe now supports MacOS and Demo![/h2]

Due to the various feedback and technical hunger, I've released several updates and demos. Thank you for your warm support and encouragement so far.

Since the last free update, I've had a lot of fun trying to solve a number of technical issues and launch them on a wider variety of platforms. For this reason, I'm feeling very good, so I'm going to have a two-week discount event.

Below are the bugs found and fixed.

- solved a lot of ax jamming.(or not.)
- Resolved the missing collision detection of several objects.

If you have any new bugs or opinions, please leave a discussion. Game production always refreshes me, so I hope I can make a game with you guys.

I'll be back ASAP.

tags.bug: - solved a lot of ax jamming.(or not.)
- Resolved the missing collision detection of several objects.

notes.title: I actually don't like winter either
notes.content:
[h2]The last stage has been updated![/h2]

As I've been doing winter, I actually don't think [b]I even like winter[/b]. For this reason, I've updated the last map based on summer to mark the winter sale. Thank you for your hot support and encouragement so far.

Currently, the new stage has been updated, and if you have purchased Press Axe, you can play it for free without purchasing DLC. As the last map to be updated, I developed it in a way that unlocks only [b]when all existing 1~2 stages are cleared[/b].

The size of the map is small compared to the existing map, but I'm sure it'll be a different experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44124863/c7753abf6e8bb4b326b536a2963d6a81883cc718.png[/img]

[h2]Other modifications[/h2]

Below are the bug fixes that have been made in addition to the stage update.

- The collision logic has been refined.

[h2]Planning after[/h2]

Now that I've completed the last map, I plan to focus on Mac/Android compatibility and porting so that we can play on multiple platforms in the future.

If you have any new bugs or comments, please leave a discussion. I'm testing and monitoring the play every day, so I'd like to make a game I make with you.

I'll be back ASAP.

tags.bug: - The collision logic has been refined.

notes.title: I Hate Summer
notes.content:
[h2]New stage updated![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44124863/2dd9654a2749fbbc4c016a5de1a04fcd54d20877.png[/img]

I hate summer. For this reason, I decided to make a [b]new winter-themed stage[/b], and I'm happy to introduce it to you according to our summer schedule. Thank you for your support and encouragement so far.

Currently, the new stage has been updated, and if you have purchased Press Axe, [b]you can play for free without purchasing DLC[/b]. The stage was set so that it could be played without clearing the previous stage, and if each stage was cleared, it would be a special display.

I also have updated PVs, images, and achievements related to this update, so I hope you enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44124863/bed6b07435bb91c895927beb921b2455461163ee.png[/img]
[i]You can do it[/i]

[h2]Other modifications[/h2]

Below are the bug fixes that have been made in addition to the stage update.

- Changed the storage scheme for Stage Clear.
- Fixed an acceleration fixed value that was not applied properly.
- Simplified the overall collision logic.
- Other than that, I fixed some strange logic and code that I don't remember.

[h2]Planning after[/h2]

After this winter stage update, I will produce the last stage using the new theme, which will be set to be activated only if the previous two stages have been cleared.

This is the last step in the production of the three stages that I promised you before, and I think I will focus on Mac/Android porting so that I can play on multiple platforms as soon as the new stage production is completed.

If you have any new bugs or comments, please leave a discussion. I do play tests and monitoring every day, so I hope we can make a game together.

I'll be back as soon as possible.

notes.title: Game Hotfix
notes.content:
There are cases where things get stuck continuously, so I proceeded with updates to solve them.

- Fixed the maximum speed of the axe at 2.5 times the maximum throw speed.
- The object's logic priority has been adjusted.
- The duck's collision logic has been adjusted.

I'm continuously modifying the content based on the play content and feedback. [b]Retention of rotational speed is temporarily suspended.[/b] If there is something wrong with the play, please leave your comment.

I'll be back as soon as possible.

notes.title: Let's getting started.
notes.content:
[h2]Press Axe has been officially released on Steam![/h2]

I also considered early access for various stage updates, but I chose the official release method because I thought I could express the game with just one stage.

I hope to present a new stage according to this summer schedule.

[h2]About the Stage[/h2]

Currently, a game with Stage 1 has been released, and is available for play for $2.99. I'm working on a new stage, and aiming to add a [b]total of 3 free stages without DLC or price increases.[/b] Please give us a lot of support.

[h2]About Save System[/h2]

I found a difference between the tester and my opinion on how to save the game. For this reason, [b]the current save feature does not exist[/b]. We will collect opinions from more diverse users and decide on the final storage method, so please feel free to start a discussion if there is any inconvenience including this.
